text: The king perishes through neglect of his duties, the ascetic through attachment, the son through excessive pampering, the Brahmin through lack of study, the family through the daughter-in-law, the clan through the worship of the wicked. Modesty is lost through intoxication, diligence through lack of vigilance, agriculture through affection, the hermitage through wandering, friendship through lack of devotion, prosperity through idleness, and wealth through negligence in renunciation.
